claim: Six design strategies for hazard geovisualizations: key data only, audience tailoring/testing, salient cues, emotion, pattern recognition aids, limited distractions.
stance_target: evidence-based map design improves hazard comprehension
quoted_support: These strategies include: Displaying only key data, tailoring and testing geovisualizations with the audience, using salient cues, leveraging emotion, aiding pattern recognition, and limiting visual distractions.
